conclusion.statement: Within the exact displayed Wang-v1 (1.8) class on every finite time interval, conservative initial traces, nonnegative temperature, mu > 0 and mu + lambda > 0, compactly supported positive-mass initial density and positive initial physical energy exclude a global solution.
conclusion.sharp_scope: Conditional absence of global solutions; no assertion that the constructed data possess local solutions.
conclusion.data_family: rho0 = c f^2, c = M / integral(f^2), u0 = 0, theta0_epsilon = epsilon rho0, 0 < epsilon <= 1; fixed smooth nonnegative compact f, fixed M > 0.
conclusion.compatibility: g_epsilon = 2 R epsilon sqrt(rho0) grad(rho0) is smooth compactly supported and satisfies the sole displayed momentum compatibility condition.
conclusion.energy: E0_epsilon = c_nu epsilon integral(rho0^2) > 0 and tends to zero; all listed initial norms and the compatibility norm share fixed upper bounds.
conclusion.virial: H'' = 4 K + 4 (R/c_nu) U >= 4 min(1,R/c_nu) E0; H <= M b^2.
conclusion.finite_time_inequality: H0 + 2 F0 t + 2 min(1,R/c_nu) E0 t^2 <= M b^2

analytic_obligations.detail: Finite q2 and gradient L2_t W1q imply integrable bounded Lipschitz velocity. Spatial convolution proves the transport identity without assuming pointwise differentiability of rho.
Use the open spacetime flow-image vacuum set, a countable rational cylinder cover and countable test families to obtain one full-measure time set independent of trajectories.
Conservative products vanish as distributions on the open spacetime vacuum region; hence -kappa Delta theta = Q there.

Log-radius circular means are nonnegative concave functions. Finite L^p forces them to vanish in the far exterior; the superharmonic mean inequality propagates zero throughout the connected flow-image exterior.
Strict dissipation positivity gives D(u)=0. Distributional rigidity and finite L^{q2} remove every affine rigid motion in the exterior.
On the common good-time set every exterior trajectory has zero velocity. All original exterior labels and the ball boundary remain fixed.
Fixed support plus gradient u_t in L2 yields u_t in L2_t H1_x by mollifier Poincare, hence a strong H1 velocity trace. Conservative momentum trace identifies its rho0-weighted kinetic energy.
The integrated heat equation makes total internal energy absolutely continuous and the conservative rho theta trace identifies its initial value.
Momentum tested by u gives K'=-integral Q+integral P div u; heat tested by a fixed cutoff gives the opposite derivative for U, with no exterior flux.
Compactly supported tests of continuity and momentum yield H'=2F and F'=2K+2(R/c_nu)U; integral div u=0.
Smooth square density, zero velocity and theta0=epsilon rho0 satisfy all displayed initial requirements with common upper bounds and fixed mass.
